model.name: TRACE-X entity risk classifier
model.fallback: transparent rule scorer, used when XGBoost is unavailable
model.training_data: Synthetic feature vectors sampled around four openly declared archetypes (fraud_core, mule, red_herring, bystander) with 6% label noise, fixed seed 42. No confirmed fraud outcomes exist in the seed dataset.
model.explainability: SHAP TreeExplainer — top six signed factors per entity
model.decision_role: Ranks the review queue. The score is never a decision and never changes an action state on its own; a named human reviews every entity before any disposition is recorded.
model.caveat: Any separation figure below is measured against the seed generator's own declared labels. It shows the pipeline distinguishes archetypes that were built to be distinguishable. It is not a real-world detection rate and must not be presented as one.

excluded.note: Victims are scored but never counted as fraud or as false positives — a victim legitimately appears in the data.

separation.caveat: Any separation figure below is measured against the seed generator's own declared labels. It shows the pipeline distinguishes archetypes that were built to be distinguishable. It is not a real-world detection rate and must not be presented as one.
